title: Tank Chair Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, Song Artists, October 4 Debut
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks presented the main promotional video, key visual, additional cast and staff members, theme song artists, and October 4 premiere for the television anime of Manabu Yashiro 's Tank Chair manga on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the opening theme song "DALALA" by reggae-punk band SiM . Musical artist Daoko is performing the ending theme song 'SYNC."

The newly announced cast members are:

Yurina Amami as Dr. Radio, a genius scientist living in hiding in an abandoned radio tower

Gen Sato as Uzu, a mysterious newcomer who joins the Class A of the "Academy"

The visual for the character Sensei, an absolute ruler with unfathomable menace and overwhelming power, and the founder of the "Academy," was also revealed:

The additional staff members are:

• CG Supervisor: Kōsuke Kawamura

• Modeling Supervisor: Daiki Seo

• Environment Supervisor: Tsubasa Hirata

• Rigging Supervisor: Mai Kawano

• Look Development Supervisor: Shinnosuke Takizawa

• Layout/Animation Supervisors: Kazukatsu Izawa, Shō Okajima, Shogo Tezuka

• BG Set-up Supervisor: Iori Suetsugu

• Art Director: Yoshikatsu Matsumoto

• Color Key Artist: Hironori Nochi

• Effects Supervisor: Taichi Sudou

• Motion Graphic Supervisor: Tatsuya Kuwahara

• Lighting and Composite Supervisor: Kaoru Tadokoro

• Editing: Hiroaki Sasa

• Sound Director: Masanori Tsuchiya

• Sound Effects: Hiromune Kurahashi

The anime will premiere on October 4 on Tokyo MX at 11:00 p.m. JST (10:00 a.m/ EDT), then on BS11 at 24:30 JST (effectively October 5 at 12:30 a.m. JST). The anime will then air on the CBC channel on October 5, and on MBS on October 6.

Kodansha USA Publishing has licensed the series, and it describes the story:

Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

The anime stars:

• Kōki Uchiyama as Nagi Taira

• Minori Fujidera as Shizuka Taira

• Gakuto Kajiwara as Naozumi Kurosaka

• Saori Hayami as Touko Kurosaka

Tadahiro Yoshihira ( Knights of Sidonia: Love Woven in the Stars ) and Hiroaki Ando ( Kaina of the Great Snow Sea , Ajin ) are directing the anime and writing the scripts at Polygon Pictures . (Yoshihira is also supervising the overall series scripts.) Yūki Moriyama ( Blame! ) is designing the characters. Masaru Yokoyama ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles , Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans ) is composing the music. Kazuma Teshigahara ( Kaina of the Great Snow Sea ) is credited for production design.

Kodansha 's K MANGA service is also publishing the series.

Yashiro debuted the manga on Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket service in November 2022. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in November 2024. Kodansha published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on March 26.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll to Release Makoto Shinkai's New Film Globally, Excluding Most of Asia
content:
Crunchyroll did not reveal details about Shinkai's new film, including its title.

Shinkai stated on social media in November 2025 he has been working on a "new film" alongside "dependable companions," adding that he could not yet formally announce the work.

Shinkai's Suzume ( Suzume no Tojimari ) film opened in Japan at #1 in November 2022. The film opened in North America in April 2023. Crunchyroll screened the film in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

Suzume ranked at #1 on its opening day on many countries' box office charts. It earned US$5,001,705 in its opening weekend in the U.S., and eventually earned over US$10 million in the country. It ended its theatrical run in Japan in May 2023 after earning 14.79 billion yen (about US$105.3 million) at the box office. Box Office Mojo lists the film with a current worldwide gross of US$221,184,739. Crunchyroll is currently streaming the film.

title: Riddle Kamimura Ends Mikiri Kara Hajimeru Garyū Kenjutsu Manga
content:
The fantasy story centers on Rio, who lives in a border town. To protect himself, he signs up for swordsmanship lessons in the town's training grounds, but quickly loses hope in the tutelage there. But in a border town that is always close to danger, he decides he still needs to learn something, and resolves to teach himself the sword.

Kamimura launched the manga in Mag Garden 's Mag Comi website in June 2023. Mag Garden released the manga's fourth compiled book volume in October 2025.

Kamimura launched the Ex-Yakuza and Stray Kitten ( Hiroware Koneko to Moto Yakuza ) manga in Mag Garden 's MAGxiv on pixiv in August 2020, and ended it in September 2022. Mag Garden released the manga's fourth volume in September 2022. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga and released the fourth volume in December 2023.

Hisumi serialized the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website from 2021 to 2022. Kadokawa published the first print novel volume in April 2022, with illustrations by Nemusuke . The second volume shipped in January 2023.

Hisumi serialized the A Serious Error in Chihaya-chan's Reputation ( Chihaya-chan no Hyōban ni Shinkoku na Error ) story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website from 2022 to 2023. Kadokawa released the first print volume in August 2024, with illustrations by Doyou . Kadokawaw released the fifth novel volume on June 10. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the novels, and will release the first volume in January 2027 under its Airship imprint.

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Mousetrap Premieres on Netflix on August 28
content:
Netflix will premiere its new mystery thriller series Mousetrap , based on the webtoon Field Mouse , on August 28. The company also unveiled the poster and English-subtitled teaser trailer:

The series follows reclusive novelist Moon-jae, whose life is turned upside down by a mysterious figure known only as "Field Mouse." In a desperate attempt to reclaim what he's lost, Moon-jae teams up with No-ja, a ruthless loan shark who once pursued him.

Hong-sun Kim directs the series, with Jun-yeol Ryu starring as Moon-jae, Kyung-gu Sul as loan shark Noja, and Kyoo-hyung Lee as detective Sun-yong.

Field Mouse was originally serialized from 2017-2020 by webtoon artist Ludovico. Its story is inspired by the Korean folktale "The Rate That Ate Fingernails," which tells the story of a rat that transforms into a human after consuming someone's fingernails.

An English version of the webtoon is not currently available.

title: Tonari no Seki no Fukami-kun ga Idol ni Naru Kamo Shirenai Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
The September issue of Shueisha 's Bessatsu Margaret magazine announced on Wednesday that Haruno Aoyama and Haruka Chizu 's Tonari no Seki no Fukami-kun ga Idol ni Naru Kamo Shirenai (Fukami-kun, the Guy Sitting Next to Me, Might Become an Idol) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on September 11.

The manga centers on a high school girl otaku of idol audition programs. She plans to produce and turn her classmate into an idol.

The manga launched in Bessatsu Margaret in September 2025. Aoyama is credited for the original work and Chizu is drawing the manga. Shueisha published the manga's first compiled book volume on February 25, and the second volume on July 23.

Aoyama launched the Boku wa Chiisana Shotenin ( I'm an Inexperienced Bookstore Clerk. ) manga in Shueisha 's now defunct The Margaret magazine in 2019. The manga ended in its sixth and final volume in 2023.

Chizu launched the Snow Angel ( Kono Setsugen de Kimi ga Waratte Irareru yō ni or literally, May this snowfield keep you smiling all the time ) manga in Shogakukan 's Cheese! magazine in May 2023. The manga ended in its fourth and final volume, which shipped in December 2024 Viz Media licensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on March 3.

title: My Hero Academia Creator’s New Manga Is Basically Jujutsu Kaisen in My Hero Academia’s Art Style
content:
Kohei Horikoshi’s My Hero Academia manga came to an end over two years ago, and as one of the biggest modern manga series to surpass 400 chapters, its absence is still deeply felt. However, the anime kept the series’ momentum alive over the past two years before finally bringing the franchise to a proper close. Now that My Hero Academia has reached its conclusion, Horikoshi has returned with a completely new concept in the one-shot horror manga Quit Laughing, Shijima . At first glance, the manga features the classic My Hero Academia art style, but its narrative foundations seem closer to Jujutsu Kaisen .

Quit Laughing, Shijima revolves around a region of Japan plagued by paranormal activity that only the male lead, Azumi, can see. As the chapter dives deeper into its nuances, it reveals that the region has followed an ancient ritual for generations, requiring the sacrifice of a chosen person every so often to keep the surrounding waters calm and prevent them from devouring the entire city. Azumi refuses to accept this fate because the latest chosen sacrifice is Shijima, the girl he has a crush on. This gives him the purpose of eradicating the spirit demanding the sacrifices, much like a sorcerer in Jujutsu Kaisen exorcising cursed spirits.

Quit Laughing, Shijima Is a Perfect Blend of My Hero Academia and Jujutsu Kaisen

Jujutsu Kaisen is fundamentally built around sorcerers exorcising Cursed Spirits born from humanity’s negative emotions. This supernatural phenomenon has existed since ancient times and is largely confined to regions of Japan. Because only sorcerers can see these spirits, they rely on cursed energy, cursed tools, and other techniques to exorcise them. This is exactly what makes Quit Laughing, Shijima ‘s narrative foundation, so similar to Jujutsu Kaisen . Much like the sorcerers, only Azumi can see these spirits, including the sacrificed victims who constantly cry out and beg others not to continue the ritual, hoping to break the cycle.

By the end of the one-shot, Azumi emerges as a vigilante, with a design that perfectly matches Deku’s rogue appearance in My Hero Academia ‘s final arc, essentially presenting a rogue Deku in action. With such elements, Quit Laughing, Shijima does emerge as a Jujutsu Kaisen -like story with fewer supernatural elements, combined with the iconic art style of My Hero Academia . It is a shame that it is only a one-shot horror manga. Perhaps Horikoshi might expand this idea and let the series embody its foundation as a shonen title with lighter fictional elements , centering on a vigilante taking down lingering legacy ghosts.

It would be truly unique and add variety to Weekly Shonen Jump, helping the magazine develop more grounded series instead of relying so heavily on supernatural stories, as it has for years. On top of that, the lack of more horror-focused shonen series is a missed opportunity, and this concept could certainly break new ground for the magazine. That said, there is no news of Kohei Horikoshi returning anytime soon, but if he does, expanding Quit Laughing, Shijima , or creating a similar narrative-driven series that resembles Jujutsu Kaisen while featuring My Hero Academia ‘s signature art style would certainly be something fans would love to see every week or two.

title: Bunny Drop's Yumi Unita Launches New Manga in September
content:
The September issue of Shodensha 's Feel Young magazine revealed last Friday that Yumi Unita will launch a new manga titled Heights Nanten ~2-mei-sama Gentei Desu~ in the magazine's next issue on September 8.

Unita launched the Nekomata Shirushi no Somemonoya-san (The Dye House with the Nekomata Mark) manga in Takeshobo 's Manga Life Original magazine in November 2023, and ended it on April 11. Takeshobo will release the manga's second and final compiled book volume on August 17.

Unita's original slice-of-life manga Bunny Drop began serializing in Shodensha 's Feel Young magazine in 2005 and ended in April 2011. Yen Press published the manga in North America. A television anime adaptation aired in Japan from July to September 2011, and a live-action film version opened in Japan in December 2011.

Seven Seas Entertainment has released Unita's Slumbering Beauty ( Nemurime Hime ) manga in English.

title: Soborou's Jukebox Manga Ends
content:
Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket platform published the final part of the final chapter of Soborou 's Jukebox manga on August 1. The third compiled book volume will ship on September 16.

The series follows the lives of the odd residents of the Jukebox dormitory, which include an angel, a demon, a wizard and apprentice, an amateur manga artist, and a genius Edo-era painter.

Soborou launched the series on Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket in August 2025. Kodansha shipped the second volume on May 15.

Soborou launched the Why the hell are you here, Teacher!? ( Nande Koko ni Sensei ga!? ) manga in 2016. Before that, Soborou published the manga as a series of one-shots under the title "Golden Times." The manga went on hiatus in August 2020 due to the author's sudden illness, and returned in August 2024. Soborou ended the manga in October 2024.

BookWalker Global is partnering with Kodansha USA Publishing to exclusively release the series digitally in English.

The manga inspired a television anime that premiered in April 2019 and an OVA episode that released in December 2019. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime and streamed it on HIDIVE and Crunchyroll . Sentai Filmworks also streamed an English dub and released the anime uncensored on home video.

Writer Shigemitsu Harada and Soborou 's Love and Peace manga ended in October 2023. The duo launched the manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine in August 2022. Kodansha published the manga's third and final volume in December 2023.

title: Live-Action Love is Better the Second Time Around Season 2 Series Reveals 3 New Cast Members, Opening Song in New Video
content:
The official website for the live-action series of Keiko Kinoshita 's Koi o Suru Nara Nidome ga Jōtō ( falling in love for the second time, bring it on ; the live-action series uses the English title Love is Better the Second Time Around ) boys-love manga started streaming a new trailer video and revealed three new cast members for the series' second season on Tuesday. The video reveals and previews the second season's opening theme song "Scenario" by artist Mel, who also performed the first season's opening theme song.

The three new cast members, who will all play as Takashi's ex-boyfriends are (image above from left to right):

• Motoki Fukami as Takaaki Hibino

• Akune Haruse (boy band ICEx member) as Rui Taniguchi

• Yūsuke Ōnuki as Sōta Arima

The Rampage male idol group member Makoto Hasegawa (left in visual right) reprises his role as Akihiro Miyata , while Robin Furuya (right) returns as Takashi Iwanaga. Other returning cast members are Aloha Takamatsu as Yūto Shiraishi, and Junya Shiraishi as Kyōsuke Sugimoto.

Yuka Yasukawa and Nao Nomura return as directors alongside new director Shinju Funabiki. Funabiki is also penning the scripts for the series. Erina Koyama is composing the music. Mamino Kawamoto is credited as LGBTQ advisor.

The second season will premiere on the "Dramaism" programming block on MBS , TBS , CBC , RKB, and HBC on September 1.

The first season premiered in March 2024.

The manga's story begins when Miyata, a business magazine editor who just entered the 10th year of his career, receives a proposal for a new column from a popular college professor named Iwanaga, who happens to be his first love. Miyata promised to elope with Iwanaga in their high school years, but got teased for it, leading to their eventual breakup. With their new professional reunion, a relationship both old and new begins.

Kinoshita launched the manga in Tokuma Shoten 's Chara Selection magazine in March 2018, and ended the series with its third compiled book volume in April 2023.

Digital Manga Publishing has previously released Kinoshita's Little Crybaby , You & Harujion , That Cute Kid is Mine and Mine , Kiss Blue , The Boyfriend Next Door , Honey Colored Pancakes , Want to Depend on You , Yuri Sensei Is In A Good Mood Today As Well , A Night Of A Thousand Nights , and You and Tonight manga in English. JManga has released Kinoshita's I Love You, Chief Clerk! manga in English.

contentBlocks.text: The Rampage male idol group member Makoto Hasegawa (left in visual right) reprises his role as Akihiro Miyata , while Robin Furuya (right) returns as Takashi Iwanaga. Other returning cast members are Aloha Takamatsu as Yūto Shiraishi, and Junya Shiraishi as Kyōsuke Sugimoto.

Yuka Yasukawa and Nao Nomura return as directors alongside new director Shinju Funabiki. Funabiki is also penning the scripts for the series. Erina Koyama is composing the music. Mamino Kawamoto is credited as LGBTQ advisor.
The second season will premiere on the "Dramaism" programming block on MBS , TBS , CBC , RKB, and HBC on September 1.
The first season premiered in March 2024.

The manga's story begins when Miyata, a business magazine editor who just entered the 10th year of his career, receives a proposal for a new column from a popular college professor named Iwanaga, who happens to be his first love. Miyata promised to elope with Iwanaga in their high school years, but got teased for it, leading to their eventual breakup. With their new professional reunion, a relationship both old and new begins.
Kinoshita launched the manga in Tokuma Shoten 's Chara Selection magazine in March 2018, and ended the series with its third compiled book volume in April 2023.

Digital Manga Publishing has previously released Kinoshita's Little Crybaby , You & Harujion , That Cute Kid is Mine and Mine , Kiss Blue , The Boyfriend Next Door , Honey Colored Pancakes , Want to Depend on You , Yuri Sensei Is In A Good Mood Today As Well , A Night Of A Thousand Nights , and You and Tonight manga in English. JManga has released Kinoshita's I Love You, Chief Clerk! manga in English.

title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Spinoff Prequel Casts Connie Nielsen, Stana Katic
content:
Nexus Point News revealed the spinoff prequel series in November 2025, which will star Wyatt Russell playing young Lee Shaw (his father Kurt Russell played the character in Monarch: Legacy of Monsters ), as well as Millie Brady, Pilou Asbaek, Corey Stoll, Ralph Ineson, and Nyasha Hatendi. The series is set in 1984, and sees the character Lee Shaw infiltrating the Soviet Union to prevent them from using a Titan monster to win the Cold War.

Joby Harold is the showrunner for the spinoff.

Monarch: Legacy of Monsters , Warner Bros. and Legendary Entertainment 's series featuring "Godzilla and the Titans" debuted with its first season worldwide on Apple TV+ in November 2023, and the second season debuted on February 27 earlier this year, ending with its 10th episode on May 1. The series is part of Legendary Entertainmment's "Monsterverse" Hollywood franchise currently includes the 2014 Godzilla film, the 2017 Kong: Skull Island film, the 2019 Godzilla: King of the Monsters film, the 2021 Godzilla vs. Kong film, and the 2024 Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire . The planned sequel to Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire is titled Godzilla x Kong: Supernova and will open on March 26, 2027.

Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire is the highest-grossing movie in the franchise , with US$570 million earnings worldwide, beating the 2017 film Kong: Skull Island , which earned US$568.8 million.
